paragraphs.en: An optional discussion prompt asks: “Are the task’s purpose and first step clear, which conditions can change, and is rest still needed?” Read alone or discuss the fictional reader, separating facts, interpretations and unknowns. No exchange of answers, pursuit of a virtue rating, disclosure of resources or proof of boundaries is required. Participation and agreement remain optional.

paragraphs.zh: 新增情境和讨论提示由费马测试编辑部原创。保留小程序28条中文陈述及新工作英译；按目前可确认的符合程度选择1至5，3“不确定或视情况”仍为数字，不是有时、中立或缺答，不新增回顾期限。七组各四题直接计入，无反向、无NA；28项全部有效才显示任何个人和、均值与解释，缺答不补零或中点。每组原始和4—20除以四，显示两位小数，保留1.25等四分之一步长。1、1、5、5与3、3、3、3同得3.00，却不表示同样的逐题反应；均值不能恢复答案、确定原因或成为单一强度。各组不相加、不抵扣、不排名、不派首要罪或美德，相同数字只说明算术相同。文化名称仅是隐喻，四枢德与三神学美德等传统不等于本七组计分，不提供科学验证或宗教背书。未建立常模、信效度、公平性、预测或中英等值。七篇公开全文无需作答即可读；复制只含公开标题及入口。答题进度仅保留在当前页面，刷新后重新开始；重新测试会清空本次作答。
paragraphs.en: FermatMind Editorial authored these additions. The original 28 Chinese statements and new working English remain. Rate currently confirmable endorsement 1–5; three, uncertain or depends on the situation, remains numeric rather than Sometimes, neutrality or missingness. No recall window is added. Seven groups of four are direct-scored without reversal or NA. All 28 must be valid before any personal sum, mean or interpretation; missingness supplies no zero or midpoint. Divide each sum, 4–20, by four and show two decimals, retaining quarter steps such as 1.25. Responses 1, 1, 5, 5 and 3, 3, 3, 3 both give 3.00 without equal item responses. Means reconstruct neither answers nor causes nor one underlying intensity. Groups are never totalled, offset, ranked or assigned as leading sins or virtues; equal numbers establish arithmetic equality only. Cultural metaphors, including traditions of four cardinal and three theological virtues, neither define these seven scoring groups nor supply scientific validation or religious endorsement. Norms, reliability, validity, fairness, prediction and language equivalence are unestablished. All seven full public readings need no answers; copying includes only the public title and entry. Answers remain in the current page only. Refreshing starts a new attempt, and retaking clears the current answers.
